requirement_breaks: When startTick == type(int24).max and the bitmap bit at compress(startTick) is set, reset returns early with currentTick = type(int24).max instead of the actual initialized tick (floor(max / tickSpacing) * tickSpacing), so getNext would return the wrong tick. Uniswap ticks are bounded by MAX_TICK and slot0 can never report this value, so the case cannot be reached and has no security effect.
